title: Satsuriku no Tenshi (ONA)
justification: AniList 104243 is the 4-episode ONA (2018-10-05 to 2018-10-26; offline-database synonyms 'Angels of Death (Episodes 13-16)'). AniDB 13307 (PREQUEL per AniList 99629) S1-S4 are "I'm Not Your God." (10-05), 'Swear You Will Be Killed by Me.' (10-12), 'A Vow Cannot Be Stolen.' (10-19), 'Stop Crying and Smile.' (10-26): four consecutive weekly specials with the same four dates. TVDB 344844 season 0 0x01-0x04 carry the same four titles on the same dates. The AniList relation is PREQUEL, not PARENT, but the AniDB node is the series the ONA continues and the episode titles are the proof.
